gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all precomputations available in the Jira system so that I can analyze the data and make informed decisions.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all precomputations with their details, including IDs, names, and associated queries.

gold.user: As a data analyst, I need to update existing precomputations with new parameters to ensure that the data reflects the latest project requirements.
gold.ideal: The API should accept the updated precomputation details and return a success message along with the updated precomputation object.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to search for a specific precomputation by its ID to retrieve its details for debugging purposes.
gold.ideal: The API should return the details of the precomputation associated with the provided ID, including its parameters and results.
